title: Dehydroabietyl squaramide incorporating chiral pyrrolidine for highly diastereo- and enantioselective Michael reaction between cyclohexanone and β-nitrostyrenes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36485-36489
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06081H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhen-Wei Zhang, Kai Xiong, Shao-Wu Liu, Yan-Qiu Deng
The (R)-pyrrolidin-2-yl-substituted dehydroabietyl squaramide served as an efficient organocatalyst for the asymmetric Michael addition of cyclohexanone to β-nitrostyrenes with high yields and good to excellent stereoselectivity.
